description:
Use this when you need a deterministic 2026 central-government office baseline and can specify Delhi/New Delhi versus outside Delhi. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a state, Union Territory, bank, employer, school, exchange, or an outside-Delhi locally selected optional-holiday calendar.
What it computes: Checks a 2026 date against the Department of Personnel and Training central-government holiday schedule, preserving Gazetted and Restricted distinctions.
Example user requests: Is 2026-10-20 a working day for India's central government office in Delhi? | Is 2026-08-28 a guaranteed closure or only a restricted holiday option outside Delhi?
Inputs: date (date); office_scope (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-10-20","office_scope":"delhi_new_delhi"} | {"date":"2026-08-28","office_scope":"outside_delhi"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, office_scope, office_scope_name, weekday, is_working_day, is_guaranteed_non_working_day, day_type, gazetted_holiday_names, restricted_holiday_names, restricted_holiday_available, calendar_scope, rest_day_policy, restricted_holiday_policy, selection_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = India Saturday/Sunday baseline and no applicable Gazetted holiday; Restricted holidays remain options
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/india-central-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/india-central-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in the pinned 2026 DoPT coverage.

office_scope.description: Required scope: delhi_new_delhi or outside_delhi. State/UT holiday calendars are not represented by this package.

name: check_india_central_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Weekly rest day, gazetted holiday, restricted option or regular weekday.

gazetted_holiday_names.description: Gazetted holidays applying to the selected central-government scope.

is_guaranteed_non_working_day.description: True for the weekly baseline or an applicable gazetted holiday.

is_working_day.description: True when the Saturday/Sunday baseline has no applicable gazetted closure.

restricted_holiday_available.description: Whether a restricted-holiday option is listed on the date.

restricted_holiday_names.description: Restricted-holiday options listed by the memorandum; these do not close the office by default.

restricted_holiday_policy.description: Restricted and locally selected optional-holiday rule.

selection_policy.description: Whether local optional selection is required.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: India Central Government Working Day
